provenance.source: NCERT Mathematics Class 8, Chapter 1 'Rational Numbers' — role of zero (additive identity) and one (multiplicative identity), and the reciprocal. Misconceptions are the recurring errors on this topic; m1 on the second concept is the same reciprocal confusion as t2, met again where it does real damage.
provenance.note: This topic lists t2 as a prerequisite on purpose. A student who still thinks additive inverse means 'flip it' cannot learn the identities, because both ideas are about what a number does to another number, and they will merge the two.

concepts.title: Zero, the additive identity
concepts.statement: Kisi bhi rational number me 0 jodne par wahi number wapas milta hai: $a + 0 = 0 + a = a$. Isiliye 0 ko additive identity kehte hain — wo jodne wale kaam me 'kuch nahi badalta'.
concepts.hook: Socho tumhare bank account me ₹1200 hain. Tumne aaj na kuch jama kiya na nikala — yaani ₹0 ka lena-dena. Shaam ko balance kitna hoga? Wahi ₹1200. Zero jodna matlab kuch na karna. Ab ek tedha sawal: agar zero kuch nahi badalta, to $5 - 0$ aur $0 - 5$ dono barabar hone chahiye na?

analogies.text: Weighing machine pe khaali thaili rakhna — reading nahi badlegi.
Cricket me ek over maiden gaya — score wahi ka wahi.

formulas.note: Zero additive identity hai — dono taraf se.
Ye dono ALAG hain. Ghatana commutative nahi hai.

misconceptions.wrong_belief: $a - 0$ aur $0 - a$ ek hi baat hai.
misconceptions.why_wrong: Jodna commutative hai par ghatana nahi. $5 - 0 = 5$ hai jabki $0 - 5 = -5$ hai — dono ka sign hi ulta hai.
misconceptions.correction: $a - 0 = a$, par $0 - a = -a$. Ghatane me order matter karta hai.
misconceptions.probe: $5 - 0$ kitna hai? Aur $0 - 5$? Kya dono same aaye?

misconceptions.wrong_belief: 0 se guna karna bhi 'kuch nahi badalta', jaise 0 jodna.
misconceptions.why_wrong: Zero jodne aur zero se guna karne me zameen-aasman ka farak hai. $a + 0 = a$ par $a \times 0 = 0$ — guna karne pe poora number khatam ho jaata hai.
misconceptions.correction: 0 jodne se kuch nahi badalta; 0 se guna karne pe sab kuch 0 ho jaata hai.
misconceptions.probe: $\frac{3}{4} + 0$ kitna hai? Aur $\frac{3}{4} \times 0$? Dono me kya farak dikha?

misconceptions.why_wrong: $\frac{0}{5} = 0$ hai kyunki 0 ko 5 hisson me baanto to har hisse me 0. Par $\frac{5}{0}$ ka koi maan hai hi nahi — 0 hisson me baantna ek kaam hi nahi hai.
misconceptions.correction: $\frac{0}{5} = 0$; $\frac{5}{0}$ undefined hai. Upar ka 0 theek hai, neeche ka 0 nahi.
misconceptions.probe: $\frac{0}{5}$ ka maan kya hai? Aur $\frac{5}{0}$ ka? Kya dono ka jawab ek hai?

misconceptions.wrong_belief: 0 additive identity hai, to wo multiplicative identity bhi hoga.
misconceptions.why_wrong: Multiplicative identity wo hai jisse guna karne par number nahi badalta — wo 1 hai, 0 nahi. $a \times 0 = 0$, jo $a$ ke barabar nahi hai (jab tak $a$ khud 0 na ho).
misconceptions.correction: Jodne ki identity 0 hai, guna ki identity 1. Do alag kaam, do alag identity.
misconceptions.probe: Guna karne par number ko na badalne wala number kaunsa hai — 0 ya 1? Ek baar $\frac{2}{3}$ pe dono try karke dekho.

worked_examples.problem: $\frac{-7}{9} + 0$ aur $\frac{-7}{9} \times 0$ — dono nikalo aur farak batao.
steps: $\frac{-7}{9} + 0 = \frac{-7}{9}$ — 0 additive identity hai, kuch nahi badla
Farak: pehle me number bacha, doosre me khatam ho gaya
$0 - \frac{3}{8}$ ka matlab hai 0 me se $\frac{3}{8}$ ghatana

concepts.title: One, the multiplicative identity, and the reciprocal
concepts.statement: Kisi bhi rational number ko 1 se guna karne par wahi number milta hai: $a \times 1 = 1 \times a = a$. Aur $\frac{a}{b}$ ka reciprocal $\frac{b}{a}$ hota hai (jab $a \neq 0$), kyunki $\frac{a}{b} \times \frac{b}{a} = 1$.
concepts.hook: Socho ek recipe hai jo 4 logon ke liye hai aur tumhe bhi 4 logon ke liye hi banani hai. Tum har cheez ko 1 se guna karoge — kuch nahi badlega. Ab socho tumne aadha kilo aata liya aur usse dugna karna hai: $\frac{1}{2} \times 2 = 1$ kilo. Ye 2 hi $\frac{1}{2}$ ka reciprocal hai. Sawal: 0 ka reciprocal kya hoga?

analogies.text: Photocopy 100% pe nikaalna — size wahi rehta hai. Wahi 1 se guna karna hai.
Gear ratio: aadha ghumana aur phir dugna ghumana — wapas wahin.

formulas.note: Negative number ka reciprocal bhi negative hota hai.

misconceptions.why_wrong: Sign badalne se 0 aata hai (additive inverse), 1 nahi. Reciprocal ke liye ULTA karna padta hai. $\frac{2}{3} \times \left(-\frac{2}{3}\right) = -\frac{4}{9}$, jo 1 nahi hai.
misconceptions.correction: Reciprocal = ulta karo. Sign badalna additive inverse hai.
misconceptions.probe: $\frac{2}{3}$ ko $-\frac{2}{3}$ se guna karo. Kya 1 aaya? To reciprocal kya hoga?

misconceptions.why_wrong: Reciprocal ki shart hai ki guna karne par 1 aaye. $0 \times$ kuch bhi $= 0$, kabhi 1 nahi aata. Aur $\frac{1}{0}$ undefined hai.
misconceptions.correction: 0 ka reciprocal hota hi nahi. Ye ekmatra rational number hai jiska reciprocal nahi hai.
misconceptions.probe: 0 ko kisi bhi number se guna karo — kya kabhi 1 aa sakta hai?

misconceptions.wrong_belief: Negative number ka reciprocal positive hota hai.
misconceptions.why_wrong: Do numbers ka guna 1 (positive) tabhi aayega jab dono ke sign same hon. $-\frac{3}{5}$ ka reciprocal $-\frac{5}{3}$ hai — check: $-\frac{3}{5} \times -\frac{5}{3} = +1$.
misconceptions.correction: Reciprocal me sign wahi rehta hai, sirf upar-neeche palat jaata hai.
misconceptions.probe: $-\frac{3}{5}$ ko $\frac{5}{3}$ se guna karo. Kya 1 aaya ya $-1$? To sahi reciprocal kya hai?

misconceptions.wrong_belief: 1 se guna karne par number thoda bad jaata hai.
misconceptions.why_wrong: $1$ multiplicative identity hai — guna ke kaam me wo bilkul kuch nahi badalta, jaise jodne me 0 kuch nahi badalta. $\frac{7}{9} \times 1 = \frac{7}{9}$.
misconceptions.correction: 1 se guna = kuch mat karo. Number jaisa tha waisa hi rahega.
misconceptions.probe: $\frac{7}{9} \times 1$ kitna hai? Number bada hua kya?

worked_examples.problem: $-\frac{4}{7}$ ka reciprocal nikalo aur verify karo.
steps: Reciprocal ke liye upar-neeche palto, sign wahi rakho: $-\frac{7}{4}$
Dono negative the, to guna positive aaya. Verified

worked_examples.problem: $\frac{5}{9}$ ka additive inverse, multiplicative inverse aur $\frac{5}{9} \times 1$ — teenon nikalo.
steps: Multiplicative inverse: ulta karo → $\frac{9}{5}$ (guna karne par 1)
$\frac{5}{9} \times 1 = \frac{5}{9}$ — 1 multiplicative identity hai, kuch nahi badla

questions.solution: 0 additive identity hai — jodne par number nahi badalta. To $\frac{-7}{9} + 0 = \frac{-7}{9}$.
0 se guna karne par har number 0 ho jaata hai. Dhyan do — $+0$ karne pe number bachta hai, $\times 0$ karne pe khatam ho jaata hai.
$0 - \frac{2}{5} = -\frac{2}{5}$. Dhyan do ki $\frac{2}{5} - 0 = \frac{2}{5}$ hota — ghatane me order badalne se sign badal jaata hai.

questions.stem: $\frac{0}{6}$ aur $\frac{6}{0}$ ke baare me kaunsa kathan sahi hai?
questions.solution: Numerator me 0 hona bilkul theek hai — $\frac{0}{6} = 0$. Denominator me 0 hona allowed nahi — $\frac{6}{0}$ undefined hai.
Pehle bracket: $\frac{4}{5} + 0 = \frac{4}{5}$ (0 additive identity hai). Phir $\frac{4}{5} \times 0 = 0$. Ye sawal jaan-bujhkar dono kaam ek saath poochhta hai.

questions.stem: Kaunsa number aisa hai ki har rational number $a$ ke liye $a + x = a$ ho?
questions.solution: $a + x = a$ tabhi hoga jab $x = 0$ ho. Isiliye 0 ko additive identity kehte hain. $x = 1$ multiplicative identity hai — wo $a \times x = a$ wale sawal ka jawab hai.

questions.stem: Samjhao ki 0 additive identity hai par multiplicative identity nahi. Dono ke liye ek-ek udaharan do.

rubric: Additive identity ki definition: jodne par number na badle
Dikhaya ki $a + 0 = a$ har rational $a$ ke liye
Multiplicative identity ki definition: guna karne par number na badle
Dikhaya ki $a \times 0 = 0 \neq a$ (jab $a \neq 0$), isliye 0 multiplicative identity nahi; wo kaam 1 karta hai

questions.solution: Additive identity wo number hai jise jodne par koi number nahi badalta. $\frac{2}{3} + 0 = \frac{2}{3}$ — 0 ye shart poori karta hai. Multiplicative identity wo hai jisse guna karne par number nahi badalta. $\frac{2}{3} \times 0 = 0$, jo $\frac{2}{3}$ nahi hai — to 0 fail ho gaya. $\frac{2}{3} \times 1 = \frac{2}{3}$ — 1 pass ho gaya. Isliye jodne ki identity 0 hai aur guna ki identity 1.
1 multiplicative identity hai — guna karne par number nahi badalta. To $\frac{7}{9} \times 1 = \frac{7}{9}$.
Reciprocal ke liye upar-neeche palto: $\frac{3}{2}$. Check: $\frac{2}{3} \times \frac{3}{2} = 1$. $-\frac{2}{3}$ additive inverse hai — usse jodne par 0 aata hai.
Reciprocal me sign wahi rehta hai, sirf upar-neeche palat jaate hain: $-\frac{5}{3}$. Check: $-\frac{3}{5} \times -\frac{5}{3} = +1$. Agar $\frac{5}{3}$ lete to $-1$ aata, 1 nahi.

questions.stem: Kis rational number ka reciprocal nahi hota?
questions.solution: 0 ko kisi bhi number se guna karo, jawab 0 hi aata hai — 1 kabhi nahi. Isliye 0 ka reciprocal hota hi nahi. Baaki sabka hota hai: 1 ka 1, $-1$ ka $-1$, aur $\frac{1}{2}$ ka 2.

questions.stem: $\frac{4}{7}$ ka reciprocal $\frac{p}{4}$ hai. $p$ ka maan kya hoga?
Kabir kehta hai: '$-\frac{2}{9}$ ka reciprocal $\frac{9}{2}$ hai.' Uski galti pakdo.

options.text: Sign chhoot gaya — $-\frac{2}{9} \times \frac{9}{2} = -1$ aata hai, 1 nahi. Sahi jawab $-\frac{9}{2}$ hai
Negative numbers ka reciprocal hota hi nahi

questions.solution: Reciprocal ki shart hai guna karne par thik $1$ aaye. $-\frac{2}{9} \times \frac{9}{2} = -1$ hai, jo 1 nahi. Sahi reciprocal $-\frac{9}{2}$ hai: $-\frac{2}{9} \times -\frac{9}{2} = 1$.

questions.stem: $a = \frac{3}{8}$ hai. $a$ ke reciprocal me $a$ ka additive inverse jodo. Jawab dashamlav me char sthaan tak likho.
0 ke alawa har rational number ka reciprocal hota hai. Samjhao ki 0 ko chhodna kyun zaroori hai, aur 1 aur $-1$ me kya khaas baat hai.

rubric: Reciprocal ki definition: guna karne par 1 aaye
0 ke liye: $0 \times x = 0$ har $x$ ke liye, to 1 kabhi nahi aa sakta
Ya: $\frac{a}{b}$ ka reciprocal $\frac{b}{a}$ hai, jo $a = 0$ pe undefined ho jaata hai
1 aur $-1$ apne khud ke reciprocal hain: $1 \times 1 = 1$ aur $-1 \times -1 = 1$

questions.solution: Reciprocal wo number hai jisse guna karne par 1 aaye. 0 ke saath ye kabhi nahi ho sakta, kyunki $0 \times x = 0$ har $x$ ke liye — 1 aane ka koi rasta hi nahi. Formula se bhi dikhta hai: $\frac{a}{b}$ ka reciprocal $\frac{b}{a}$ hai, aur $a = 0$ pe $\frac{b}{0}$ undefined ho jaata hai. 1 aur $-1$ khaas hain kyunki wo apne khud ke reciprocal hain — $1 \times 1 = 1$ aur $-1 \times -1 = 1$. Sirf yahi do rational numbers aisa karte hain.
